entities.summary: Shashanka, a notable figure in the history of Bangladesh, associated with Gupta and Pala Golden Ages (300 BCE–600). Preceded by Gupta Empire. Their legacy influenced King Shashanka of Gauda emerges as Bengal's first significant independent ruler and Pala Dynasty and Buddhist Civilization.
